Draft a complete Meta-Narrative Theory argument document addressing the domain or objection: **$input**

## Requirements

1. filename: suggest an `UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES.md` name following the pattern `{DOMAIN}_ARGUMENT.md`
2. Check [meta-narrative/arguments/README.md](../../meta-narrative/arguments/README.md) — if a very similar argument exists, extend it instead of creating a duplicate
3. Follow this exact document structure:

```
# [DOMAIN] AND META-NARRATIVE [SCIENCE/THEORY/ARGUMENT]

## Overview
[One paragraph]

---

## [Domain] Objections
- **[Objection Name]:** [Description]
(2–5 total)

---

## Meta-Narrative Response
- [Response citing one of the 12 Laws, a Protocol, or a Math equation]
(One response per objection)

---

## References
- [Relevant Law](../../meta-narrative/laws/...)
- [Relevant Math](../../meta-narrative/math/...)

---
*Open for future expansion and respectful debate.*
```

4. Cross-reference at least one of the 12 core laws: Law of Entropy, Law of Restoration, Law of Three, Law of Duality, Law of Agency, Law of Recursion, Law of Emergence, Law of Alignment, Law of Narrative Branching, Law of Feedback, Law of Conservation, Law of Observer Principle
5. After drafting, show the README row entry to add to `meta-narrative/arguments/README.md`

Use inclusive, clear language accessible across all educational backgrounds.
